date.description: Required caller date phrase: aaj/today, kal/tomorrow, or an explicit date. Relative dates are resolved at request time using the clinic timezone (Asia/Kolkata by default).

time.description: Required appointment time. Normalize spoken times to HH:mm, for example 12 baje to 12:00 or shaam 5 baje to 17:00.

doctor_name.description: Required exact doctor name from clinic_info.doctors, or an empty string to check all configured/known clinic doctors. Never invent a doctor.
